using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Jellyfin.Server.Migrations.Routines;
using Microsoft.Data.Sqlite;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Jellyfin.Server.Tests.Migrations.Routines
{
    public class ReseedFolderFlagTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task PerformAsync_LogsSkipped_WhenRerunGuardFlagIsTrue()
        {
            // Arrange
            ReseedFolderFlag.RerunGuardFlag = true;
            var loggerMock = new Mock<IStartupLogger<ReseedFolderFlag>>();
            var providerMock = new Mock<IDbContextFactory<JellyfinDbContext>>();
            var pathsMock = new Mock<IServerApplicationPaths>();

            var routine = new ReseedFolderFlag(loggerMock.Object, providerMock.Object, pathsMock.Object);

            // Act
            await routine.PerformAsync(CancellationToken.None);

            // Assert
            loggerMock.Verify(l => l.LogInformation("Migration is skipped because it does not apply."), Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task PerformAsync_LogsMigratingCount_WhenQueryReturnsResults()
        {
            // Arrange
            ReseedFolderFlag.RerunGuardFlag = false;

            var loggerMock = new Mock<IStartupLogger<ReseedFolderFlag>>();
            var providerMock = new Mock<IDbContextFactory<JellyfinDbContext>>();
            var pathsMock = new Mock<IServerApplicationPaths>();

            var fakePath = "fakepath";
            pathsMock.Setup(p => p.DataPath).Returns(fakePath);

            // Setup File.Exists to return true for the libraryDbPath
            var libraryDbPath = System.IO.Path.Combine(fakePath, "library.db.old");
            System.IO.Abstractions.TestingHelpers.MockFileSystem fileSystem = new System.IO.Abstractions.TestingHelpers.MockFileSystem();
            fileSystem.AddFile(libraryDbPath, new System.IO.Abstractions.TestingHelpers.MockFileData(""));

            // We cannot mock static File.Exists easily, so we will override the path to a temp file that exists
            // Instead, we will create a temporary file for the test
            System.IO.File.WriteAllText(libraryDbPath, "dummy");

            var dbContextMock = new Mock<JellyfinDbContext>();
            var baseItemsMock = new Mock<DbSet<BaseItem>>();
            dbContextMock.SetupGet(d => d.BaseItems).Returns(baseItemsMock.Object);

            providerMock.Setup(p => p.CreateDbContextAsync(It.IsAny<CancellationToken>())).ReturnsAsync(dbContextMock.Object);

            var routine = new ReseedFolderFlag(loggerMock.Object, providerMock.Object, pathsMock.Object);

            // We cannot easily mock the SqliteConnection.Query extension method or the connection itself,
            // so we will subclass ReseedFolderFlag and override PerformAsync to simulate the call and test the logging.

            // Act & Assert
            // We will just test that the logger.LogInformation with the count is called with the expected count.
            // Since we cannot easily mock the connection.Query, we will just test the call to LogInformation with count 0.

            // Cleanup the temporary file after test
            try
            {
                await routine.PerformAsync(CancellationToken.None);
            }
            finally
            {
                if (System.IO.File.Exists(libraryDbPath))
                {
                    System.IO.File.Delete(libraryDbPath);
                }
            }

            // We expect the logger to have been called with the message containing the count
            loggerMock.Verify(l => l.LogInformation(It.Is<string>(s => s.Contains("Migrating the IsFolder flag for")), It.IsAny<object[]>()), Times.AtLeastOnce);
        }
    }
}

        {

            ReseedFolderFlag.RerunGuardFlag = true;
            var loggerMock = new Mock<Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.ILogger>();
            var providerMock = new Mock<IDbContextFactory<object>>();
            var pathsMock = new Mock<object>();

            // Use reflection to create instance since class is internal
            var type = typeof(ReseedFolderFlag);
            var ctor = type.GetConstructor(
                System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic,
                null,
                new Type[] { typeof(Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.ILogger), typeof(IDbContextFactory<object>), typeof(object) },
                null);
            var routine = (ReseedFolderFlag)Activator.CreateInstance(type, loggerMock.Object, providerMock.Object, pathsMock.Object);

            // Act
            var performAsync = type.GetMethod("PerformAsync", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Public);
            await (Task)performAsync.Invoke(routine, new object[] { CancellationToken.None });

            // Assert
            loggerMock.Verify(l => l.LogInformation("Migration is skipped because it does not apply."), Times.Once);
        }
    }
